title: Partition Array Into Three Parts With Equal Sum
goal: Decide whether two cuts create three nonempty parts with equal sums.
strategy: The total fixes each target sum. Close two matching prefixes as early as possible and leave a nonempty suffix; its sum must then be the same target.
